entries.relational_slices_section: Routed reads, joins, CTEs, and streaming
entries.current_evidence: Recursive CTE lowering admits materialization through stream spill policy and routed materialization tracking shares spill and hard-cap accounting for bounded execution.
entries.missing_evidence: CTE and recursive CTE execution still needs durable spill-store streaming with backpressure, resumable cursors, bounded memory, spill accounting, and reopen/resume evidence instead of bounded in-memory materialization only.
entries.evidence_symbol: lowered sql recursive cte materialization admission uses stream spill policy

entries.relational_slices_section: Routed reads, joins, CTEs, and streaming
entries.current_evidence: Paginated routed row-query plans collect owner ranges, lookup-revalidate every scanned key/version/json, then rescan each routed range before applying global order/distinct/limit/offset. Exact range rescan mismatch fails closed with TopologyChanged, including an inserted row appearing in an already scanned range, so paginated reads do not return duplicate or missing rows across live owner-range movement.
entries.evidence_symbol: routed rows query plan executes over scanned owner rows with ctes

entries.relational_slices_section: Routed reads, joins, CTEs, and streaming
entries.current_evidence: Typed join requests carry optional cardinality estimates and right-side lookup-index hints. Strategy selection records the effective row counts and lookup-index hint used, chooses lookup/hash/merge deterministically, fails closed for explicit lookup when the lookup index is unavailable, fails closed for unproven merge input ordering, and falls back to observed row counts when estimates are missing. The API-facing rows join contract parses planning_hints JSON, executes hinted hash and hinted auto-merge plans, and encodes the selected strategy and hint values in the response.
entries.evidence_symbol: relational rows join contract accepts typed equality join plans

entries.relational_slices_section: Routed reads, joins, CTEs, and streaming
entries.current_evidence: Routed merge joins are release-gated as deterministic fail-closed for unproven routed source shapes. Typed sorted-input proof accepts only leading ascending field orders on the join keys and rejects wrong fields, descending order, expression order keys, and null-test order keys. Routed read preflight rejects merge joins with range fanout, filters, limit, or offset before scanning, while locally materialized sorted inputs can still execute merge strategy with explicit strategy selection.
entries.evidence_symbol: relational rows join sorted input proof requires leading ascending join key order
